sloka: सा पुरा दिव्यसङ्काशा वर्षे द्वादशमे शुभे ।निविष्टा शूरसेनानां विषयश्चाकुतोभयः ।। ७.७०.९ ॥
transliteration: sā purā divyasaṅkāśā varṣe dvādaśame śubhe ।niviṣṭā śūrasenānāṁ viṣayaścākutobhayaḥ ।। 7.70.9 ॥

translations.english: That city, resembling a divine abode, was established in the auspicious twelfth year, becoming a region for brave warriors, free from all fear.
